purpose: test whether census 005's 0.0% was earned or was an artefact of a reading rubric that had drifted
rubric: the census-003/004 wording, WITHOUT the 'What is NOT a fault' section that census 005 used
instruction: told the notes had passed a read that found nothing, and to establish whether that was soundness or leniency, without manufacturing faults
finding: the rubric change made the readers more permissive. Census 005's 0.0% does not stand as measured.

failure.why: the gloss 'of or associated with or requiring the use of the mind' is relational and carries no judgement; the note singled out the 'requiring' disjunct and inflated it into 'demanding real thought' to justify a positive charge
failure.repair: charge 1 -> 0, note rewritten to name the domain rather than praise the work; re-read blind by a further reader: right
